function.name: verify_customer
function.description: Verifies customer identity using the last 4 digits of PAN or birth year. This tool must succeed before any debt information is disclosed.

verification_code.description: Customer-provided last 4 PAN digits or birth year.

function.name: log_promise_to_pay
function.description: Logs a customer Promise-to-Pay after the customer has been authenticated.

amount.description: Amount the customer committed to pay.

function.name: send_payment_link
function.description: Sends a payment link to the customer's registered contact channel after authentication and a valid resolution.

function.name: escalate_to_agent
function.description: Routes a hardship, dispute, or other eligible issue to a human collections/resolution agent.

function.name: mark_disposition
function.description: Logs the final outcome of the call.
